title: Learner questions pile up
description: About six weeks before the start date, learners start asking the support team many more questions, most of them about the same few things: certificates, billing and their account. The team of three answers more and more slowly, from the same or the next day to several days later, and a backlog of unanswered questions builds up. Everything else stays as usual.
expected_finding: The goal of answering every learner question within one business day is missed: the agent measures, from the application's own logs, many more questions waiting longer than a business day than the goal allows, and raises a goal gap on it. This needs the presenter to confirm the goal's measurement in the console, and the measured week is real live activity after loading (see the README).
experimental_reason: The Governance Agent can only measure a goal from application logs by COUNTING log lines of one log route, filtered by level, error class or a template it parsed from literal logger calls (packages/platform/business-data/source-binding.js validateSourceBindingShape: operation must be 'count', filter takes levels / error_class / template only). It cannot pair support_request_created with support_reply_sent, compute a time between them, a ratio, or read 'value' (no time_between / ratio / avg over logs), and it does not see event names (LearnLoop's logEvent({ event }) calls are not literal-message call sites, shared.js CALL_SITE). The closest measurable shape is the daily support backlog check: one 'SupportReplyTimeout' warning per open question past one business day, counted per ISO week by error class (aws-log-source-reader.js ERROR_CLASS_PARSE). Those lines must be in CloudWatch Logs (/aws/lambda/learnloop-prod-admin, a rank-1 log route from the function's LoggingConfig): the S3 app-logs history is not usable for this (the bucket is only a rank-4 candidate, objects are chosen by LastModified, at most MAX_S3_OBJECTS_PER_RUN = 100 per read, so every read is partial and measurement skips partial aggregates). So the measured week is LIVE: the deployed check_support_backlog job reads the loaded support_requests.json every day at 07:00 UTC and logs about 33-40 warnings a day for the open backlog, i.e. 230-280 in the first complete ISO week, against the business review's stated baseline of about 1 a week and target 0 (NBF-DRIFT-GOAL_GAP fires on any negative oriented gap, packages/modules/new-evolution-opportunity/gap/index.js gapBasis; at least MIN_GROUP_SIZE = 10 lines). Not yet observed live; needs confirmation: the log route's parse coverage stays at or above PARSE_COVERAGE_FLOOR_PCT = 80 with Lambda's own platform lines in the log group, and log-route detection is API only (POST .../log-routes/detections).
